thread:
Maya (docs): Heads up — CI on PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 failed with linkcheck complaining about a missing fragment. Error references an anchor generated from a table caption (something like 'table-summary-cost') but Docusaurus and MkDocs are slugifying differently.
Eric (platform): Hmm, that's annoying. MkDocs seems to turn table captions into `table-summary-cost` while Docusaurus may emit `table-summary-cost-1` or skip it. We should either add explicit ids or normalize slugify.
Maya (docs): Quick patch idea: give the table an explicit id in the source so both generators resolve the same anchor. Example:
```markdown
| Plan | Cost |
|------|------|
| Basic | $0 |
{#table-summary-cost}
```
Jia (engineering): If we add explicit ids we need to backfill about ~20 cross-page links. Could we instead add a build plugin to normalize slug generation across builders? That might be a larger lift.
Alex (devex): CI output snippet: `ERROR: linkcheck failed - fragment 'table-summary-cost' not found (from /docs/usage/pricing.md)` — looks like the link is present but the target id didn't match.
CI Bot: build/docs#4321 — linkcheck failed (exit code 1).
Maya (docs): @Alex can you open a tiny PR that adds explicit ids for the affected tables? I'll prepare a follow-up that updates the links to the canonical ids and include a note in the PR description about why we're doing it.
Alex (devex): Yep, I'll batch the table-id additions into one docs-only PR to keep CI churn low. I'll also add a comment with a regex we can use to find table captions that lack ids.
Jia (engineering): :thumbsup: I'll run a quick script to enumerate anchors in the generated HTML for both builders and produce a mapping file we can include as a sanity check. If we find systematic differences we can escalate to a slugify plugin instead.
Maya (docs): Thanks — once Alex opens the PR I'll add the list of links to update and ping the reviewers. Also adding a small linkcheck test to the docs CI may help catch regressions earlier.
Eric (platform): No runtime impact for infra, this is docs-only. Go ahead with the explicit ids + link updates plan. If we later want to normalize slugify, file a tech-debt ticket.
Maya (docs): Cool. I'll add a checklist in the PR: (1) add explicit ids for affected tables, (2) update cross-page links, (3) run linkcheck locally with both builders, (4) add a short CI note.
Alex (devex): PR here when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330 — includes the table ids and a redirect map suggestion.
Maya (docs): Perfect — tagging reviewers & I'll kick off the local linkcheck.
CI Bot: Note: rerun build after PR updates to verify linkcheck passes.
